a11y.apg: No APG pattern: the container is role="log" with aria-live="polite", which is the practice for a conversation — it is read in the order it arrives. This differs from NotificationCenter on purpose: a feed you revisit at your own pace must NOT be a live region. Nothing is focusable.

props.name: messages
props.description: The conversation, as data: {id, body, author?, time?, avatar?, status?}. Transport and state are yours; this renders.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the log region. Name it when a page holds more than one conversation.

props.name: className
props.description: On the container, which is also the live region.
